specification.objective: Align the Backlog Ações header with its existing row action cell so displayed table values are not mislabeled, while preserving the existing action controls position and behavior.

requirements.statement: The dedicated Ações header occupies the same index as the row's permission-aware action controls; other row fields retain their existing order.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A regression test inspects the DataTable and verifies the Ações header is at index 2, each row has one cell per column, and each row's cell at index 2 contains the action controls.

invariants.statement: Only the Ações header position changes; preserve every existing row cell, action control, callback, permission, sorting, filtering, and layout behavior.

forbidden_states.statement: Actions appear beneath a non-actions header, or any field value is shifted beneath a different header.

inputs.statement: The declared Backlog DataTable columns and each visible card's DataRow cells.

outputs.statement: A Backlog table whose row cell positions match their column headers.

failure_semantics.statement: The focused regression test fails with backlog_actions_column_order when the Ações header is not at index 2, row cell counts do not match the column count, or action controls are not at the matching index.

argv: backlog puts row controls in a dedicated actions column
backlog puts row controls in a dedicated actions column
